written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Robin has a hidden additive mood score: insult -15, apology +10, gift -4; warm iff score is positive.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Robin compares total apologies with total insults; gifts are irrelevant; warm iff apologies outnumber insults.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Robin's hidden mood decays by half each action, then adds insult -2, apology +1, gift 0; warm iff final score is positive.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Robin tracks a hidden grudge: insults add 1, apologies and gifts remove 1 if possible; warm only after an apology and with grudge 0.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Mood is a decaying score: decay 0.75, insult -1, apology +0.6, gift +0.2; warm iff positive.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Mood is a decaying score: decay 0.5, insult -1, apology +0.5, gift +0.1; warm iff positive.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Robin is warm if there are no insults, or exactly one insult and an apology occurs after it.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Robin is warm if there are no insults, or if she ends with an apology and never had two insults in a row.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Robin's grudge is reduced twice as much by gifts before any apology has happened.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Robin's grudge is softened by gifts only before any apology; after an apology, gifts are ignored.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Robin tracks a grudge and a favor balance; gifts at zero become favor that absorbs later insults, while apologies clear favor.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Robin reduces a grudge with a gift only when the gift immediately follows an insult.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 2
survivors.comment: Robin's grudge is softened by gifts only before any apology; after an apology, gifts are ignored.

shown the survivors.comment: Robin has a grudge counter; insults add, apologies subtract and set hasApology, gifts subtract only before any apology; warm only if apologized and grudge is zero.

shown the facts only.comment: Track hidden anger: insult +1; apologise -1 (min 0); gift -1 only if anger >= 2; warm iff anger is 0.
